show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/gS6LUX
show.description: Shaurya goes undercover as Aarohi’s security guard to shield “Sunspire,” a potential cancer cure worth killing for.   But the mastermind after her carries the bloodline of the man who destroyed Shaurya’s family.  Protect her, or destroy them; either way, Shaurya is going to war.
